n41_pair_domains: four same-rotation W6 domains with 1956 exact signed distinct-column pair witnesses each
n41_computation: Enumerate all group sums of pair domains 2 and 3, sort packed exact points, count distinct sums and identity; then test fixed-Q residuals from pair domains 0 and 1 with four-prefix-column exclusions. Count full-domain membership hits before eight-column witness checks.
n131_condition: For a uniformly random nonidentity target, each queried first-two-pair prefix is fixed without using the target coordinates or a target-dependent candidate generator. The queried residual is uniform on a translated set of r-1 points. A predeclared sequence of such prefixes has success probability at most L*|D2+D3|/(r-1).
n131_pair_domain_upper: binomial(262614,2) per pair window before folded-column exclusions
stop_rule: Complete exact N41 sumset census and all first-two-pair public-target probes, or record time/memory cap with partial counts; derive the N131 union bound without extrapolating host timing.
claim_boundary: Exact bound for target-independent two-fixed-pair prefix schedules under the specified uniform target law. The N41 census measures one frozen public point and exact same-rotation W6 domains. Target-coordinate-guided or joint symbolic search is outside the bound.
